clue.text: Criticise expert when exposing universal remedies

parts.note: to pan a show is to criticise it harshly
an ace is an expert
as can mean when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: Someone attacks an authority for exposing supposed cure-alls.
explanation.definitionFit: Cure-alls that supposedly fix every ailment are exactly what the plural noun names.

clue.text: Take a seat during procession without duke, a hanger-on

indicators.note: during means the sitting happens inside the procession word
without means the letter for duke is taken out

parts.note: a parade is a procession
to sit is to take a seat

explanation.surface: A sponger sits down in the middle of a parade the duke has left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' removes D from PARADE, leaving PARAE.
explanation.definitionFit: A parasite is someone who lives off others, a sponger.

clue.text: Magnificent old gold coin

definitions.meaning: a former English gold coin worth a third of a pound

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means stately and grand; the noun is a historic English gold coin.

clue.text: Plays, relaxing in company, a song

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit inside the abbreviation
relaxing suggests the letters loosen and rearrange

explanation.surface: Plays performed in a relaxed way in company include a song.
explanation.definitionFit: A calypso is a Caribbean style of song, so an example.

clue.text: A number climbing in line to be turned round

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing reads the word upwards, so backwards

parts.note: six is a number

explanation.surface: A figure climbs up in a queue to be spun around.
explanation.definitionFit: An axis is the line about which something rotates.

clue.text: Evil immoral sailor

parts.note: sin is evil wrongdoing
bad means immoral or wicked

explanation.surface: A wicked, depraved seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: Sinbad is the legendary sailor of the Arabian Nights tales.
explanation.definitionFit: The fictional seafarer of the Arabian Nights voyages, so an example of the definition.

clue.text: I'm to turn out, come along

parts.note: to prove is to turn out, as in it proved true

explanation.surface: I'm going to show up, come on.
explanation.definitionFit: To come along means to progress or get better.

clue.text: Encourage children to get previous publication

parts.note: to back is to support or encourage
issue means offspring or children

explanation.surface: Encourage the kids to get an old magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: An earlier edition of a magazine or periodical.

clue.text: Daughter's target: formal evening meal

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter
the inner is the ring of a target nearest the bull

explanation.surface: A daughter aims for a smart evening dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: The main meal eaten in the evening, a direct synonym.

clue.text: About to call one about uprising

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to give someone a bell is British slang for phoning them
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means about, as in a talk on history

explanation.surface: Something concerning a phone call about a revolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolt against authority, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Emperor's granny concealing Eastern European origins, originally

indicators.note: the granny word hides the other letters inside it

parts.note: nan is an informal word for grandmother
a Pole comes from Poland in Eastern Europe

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: An emperor's grandmother hides her Eastern European roots.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after Emperor stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon Bonaparte was Emperor of the French, an example.

clue.text: Nut infiltrating Cape Canaveral

indicators.note: the answer has got inside the words that follow, lying across them

explanation.surface: A nut smuggled into the Florida space centre.
explanation.definitionFit: A pecan is a kind of nut from a North American hickory tree.

clue.text: Guide that woman inside hydro

indicators.note: the pronoun is placed within the health-resort word

parts.note: a hydro is a British term for a spa hotel offering water cures
her refers to that woman

explanation.surface: A guide finds that woman inside the health resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas are Himalayan people famous as mountain guides and porters.

clue.text: A quiet Italian river location may be suitable

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
the Po is the main river of northern Italy
a site is a location

explanation.surface: A tranquil spot by an Italian river might make a fitting place.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fitting or relevant to the occasion is a close synonym.

clue.text: Newspaper boss, English, wearing appalling strides

indicators.note: the rearranged trousers go around the English letter like clothing
appalling signals the letters are messed up

explanation.surface: An English newspaper boss wears dreadful trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strides' is British slang for trousers; 'appalling' makes DITRESS from STRIDES.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated term for a female editor, who runs a newspaper.

clue.text: Hotels ignored comic opera

indicators.note: comic suggests the letters are clowning about and rearranged

explanation.surface: The hotels paid no attention to a funny opera.
explanation.walkthrough: The Gondoliers is a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera, so 'comic' also fits the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A Gilbert and Sullivan stage work, so an example of the definition.

clue.text: Watch the first man in for a surprise

parts.note: to eye is to watch
in cricket the opener is the first batsman in

explanation.surface: Watch the opening batsman for something surprising.
explanation.definitionFit: An eye-opener is something revealing or surprising.

clue.text: Sloppy fielders keep dropping Leicestershire's opener

parts.note: slips are close catching fielders in cricket

indicators.note: dropping means a letter is lost from the word

parts.note: to hold is to keep

indicators.note: the first letter of the county name is taken

explanation.surface: Careless fielders keep dropping catches off Leicestershire's opening batsman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dropping' removes L, the first letter of Leicestershire, an English cricket county, from HOLD.
explanation.definitionFit: Slipshod means careless and slapdash, a synonym.

clue.text: A few in their glee dancing a Scottish dance

indicators.note: the small quantity sits inside the rearranged letters
dancing suggests the letters are moving about

parts.note: some means a few

explanation.surface: Several people in their joy dance a Scottish reel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dancing' makes EIGHTREEL; 'A few' supplies the four letters that go 'in'. The eightsome reel is danced by eight people.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish country dance for eight people, so an example of the definition.

clue.text: Angler at sea, about last to drop anchor

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go about the final letter
at sea means confused, so the letters are jumbled
the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: An angler out on the water is about to drop anchor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' makes GRANEL from ANGLER; 'about' puts it around P.
explanation.definitionFit: A grapnel is a small anchor with several flukes.

clue.text: Rot shown in elm, primarily, and two other trees

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter is taken

parts.note: yew is one tree
ash is the other tree

explanation.surface: Decay shows up in an elm and two more trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyewash is nonsense, and rot means nonsense in British slang.

clue.text: New zebra crossing good? Capital

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go across the good letter, enclosing it
new suggests a fresh arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: A new zebra crossing is good in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' makes ZAREB from ZEBRA; a zebra crossing is a British pedestrian crossing with stripes.
explanation.definitionFit: Zagreb is the capital of Croatia, an example.

clue.text: Man reportedly to assist in the making of this children's soup

definitions.text: the making of this children's soup

indicators.note: reportedly means the man's name is as heard when spoken

parts.note: Alf is a man's name, short for Alfred
to abet is to assist

explanation.surface: A man is said to help prepare a soup for children.
explanation.walkthrough: Alphabet soup contains pasta letters, so the letters are what make it.
explanation.definitionFit: Alphabet soup has pasta shapes of letters, so the set of letters makes it up.

clue.text: Maintain board's winning

parts.note: keep is board and lodging, as in earning one's keep
up means ahead or winning, as in two goals up

explanation.surface: Food and lodging maintains its success.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain or continue something is the phrasal verb's meaning.

clue.text: Cut-glass object teacher put up in the course of the afternoon

indicators.note: the teacher word comes within the time of day

parts.note: PM means the afternoon

indicators.note: in a down clue put up means read upwards, backwards

parts.note: sir is how pupils address a male teacher

explanation.surface: The teacher puts up a glass object during the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: A prism is a cut-glass block that splits light.

clue.text: Most of panel on a Hebridean island

indicators.note: most of means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a jury is a panel

explanation.surface: Most of a panel on a Scottish island.
explanation.walkthrough: The Hebrides are islands off western Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Jura is an island in the Inner Hebrides, an example.

clue.text: Arrest knight overwhelmed by bankruptcy

indicators.note: the knight is swamped by, so placed inside, the other word

parts.note: ruin is financial collapse
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight is arrested after going bust.
explanation.definitionFit: A run-in is informal for an arrest or a clash with the police.

clue.text: Around end of game, playing squash, I'm nauseous

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go around the final letter
playing suggests the letters are moved about
the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Near the end of the match, playing squash, I feel sick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' reorders the eight letters to SQUAMISH; 'Around' wraps that round the E from the end of 'game'.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling queasy or sick, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Only just save the Spanish close to bankruptcy

parts.note: bar means except or save
el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: the closing letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Barely rescuing the Spanish from going bust.
explanation.definitionFit: A synonym meaning by the smallest margin, scarcely.

clue.text: Understood female in diamonds

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
D is the card abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A woman wearing diamonds grasped it.
explanation.definitionFit: To have fathomed something is to have worked it out, a synonym.
